Method of Attack: Privilege escalation and remote code execution via removal of authentication header
Used to obtain initial access and move laterally within Azure environments
Dropping botnet malware (Mirai) and cryptomining payloads
Closes exploited ports to prevent other botnets takeover
Impacted Systems: Azure Linux VMs with vulnerable OMI software agent
Attack Vector: Exploitation of OMI software agent vulnerabilities (CVE-2021-38647) on exposed Azure Linux VMs
Indicators of Compromise: Scanning from over 110 servers targeting CVE-2021-38647
Ports TCP 5985, 5986, and 1207 exposed and exploited
